passages.title: 史上最賺錢的巡迴演唱會
passages.text: On December 8, 2024, Taylor Swift played the last show of her {1}, the Eras Tour, in Vancouver, Canada. The {2} started in March 2023 and went to five continents. In about 21 months, she played 149 shows, and it became the highest-earning concert tour in history, with more than two billion US dollars in ticket sales. Fans from all over the world made long {3} to see her. In many cities, {4} near the stadium were fully booked, and local shops and restaurants got much busier. Some people even flew to another country because tickets there were easier to get. My cousin flew from Taipei to Singapore to see the show in March 2024. She said that when she arrived at the {5}, she saw many fans wearing glitter and friendship bracelets. "It felt like the concert started before I even left the airport!" she said.

blanks.why: the last show of her tour「她巡迴演唱會的最後一場」，後面的 the Eras Tour 是巡演名稱。soup（湯）、fever（發燒）、cough（咳嗽）都沒有「最後一場表演」。
The tour started in March 2023「這場巡演從 2023 年 3 月開始」。spoon（湯匙）、towel（毛巾）、sock（襪子）都不會「開始」並跑遍五大洲。
made long trips「長途旅行」，make a trip 是「去旅行」。lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）、pumpkins（南瓜）都不能和 make 搭配表示旅程。
hotels were fully booked「飯店都被訂滿了」。coughs（咳嗽）、fevers（發燒）、sugars（糖）都不能被「預訂」住宿。
arrived at the airport「抵達機場」，因為她是搭飛機去的，後面也說 left the airport。blanket（毯子）、soup（湯）、sock 都不是抵達的地點。

passages.zh: 2024 年 12 月 8 日，泰勒絲在加拿大溫哥華唱完「時代巡迴演唱會」的最後一場。這場巡演從 2023 年 3 月開始，跑遍五大洲。在大約 21 個月裡，她一共唱了 149 場，門票收入超過 20 億美元，成為史上最賺錢的巡迴演唱會。世界各地的歌迷長途跋涉去看她。在很多城市，體育場附近的飯店都被訂滿，當地的商店和餐廳也變得忙碌許多。有些人甚至因為別國的票比較好買，就飛到國外去看。我表姊在 2024 年 3 月從台北飛到新加坡看演唱會。她說一到機場，就看到很多歌迷戴著亮片和友誼手環。她說：「我覺得演唱會在我離開機場之前就開始了！」

passages.title: 日本迎來四千萬名旅客
passages.text: In 2025, Japan welcomed about 42.7 million visitors from other countries, the most ever. It was the first time the number went over 40 million. Many visitors came from South Korea, China, and Taiwan. They enjoyed Japanese food, hot springs, and shopping, and the weak yen made their {1} cheaper than before. But so many tourists also caused problems. Some famous places became very crowded, and {2} in cities like Kyoto were hard to book. My family went on a {3} to Osaka last winter. When we landed, the line at the {4} was so long that it took us over an hour to show our {5} and get through. My dad joked, "It feels like the whole world is in Japan today!" Still, we had a wonderful time and ate ramen every single day.

blanks.why: made their trips cheaper「讓他們的旅行比較便宜」，日圓貶值讓旅費降低。soups（湯）、fevers（發燒）、coughs（咳嗽）都和日圓匯率無關。
hotels were hard to book「飯店很難訂」。spoons（湯匙）、socks（襪子）、lemons（檸檬）都不能「預訂」。
went on a trip to Osaka「去大阪旅行」，go on a trip 是固定用法。cough、sugar（糖）、towel（毛巾）都不能和 go on a … to 地點 搭配。
the line at the airport「機場的排隊人龍」，因為剛降落。candle（蠟燭）、blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）都不是降落後排隊的地方。
show our passports「出示護照」，入境時要給海關看。fevers、sugars、soups 都不能出示來通關。

passages.zh: 2025 年，日本迎來大約 4,270 萬名外國旅客，創下歷史新高，這也是人數第一次超過四千萬。很多旅客來自韓國、中國和台灣。他們享受日本的美食、溫泉和購物，日圓走弱也讓旅行比以前便宜。但觀光客太多也帶來問題：有些知名景點變得非常擁擠，京都等城市的飯店也很難訂。我們家去年冬天去大阪旅行。降落後，機場的排隊人龍長到我們花了一個多小時才出示完護照、通過入境。爸爸開玩笑說：「今天好像全世界的人都在日本！」不過我們還是玩得很開心，每天都吃拉麵。

passages.title: 世界最佳機場又是樟宜
passages.text: In April 2025, Singapore's Changi Airport was named the best {1} in the world at the Skytrax World Airport Awards. It took the top spot back from Doha's Hamad International Airport, which had won the year before. Changi is famous for more than its flights. Inside the Jewel, a building connected to the {2}, there is the world's tallest indoor waterfall, surrounded by trees and gardens. Travelers can also find movie theaters, a butterfly garden, and even a {3} where they can rest between flights. Last summer, my family stopped in Singapore on our {4} to Australia. We had seven hours to wait, but we were never bored. My little brother wanted to stay at the waterfall forever. "Can we skip Australia and live here?" he asked. My mom laughed and held up our {5}. "Sorry, the plane won't wait for us!"

blanks.why: the best airport in the world「世界最好的機場」，樟宜是機場。spoon（湯匙）、sock（襪子）、lemon（檸檬）都不能在機場大獎中得獎。
a building connected to the airport「一棟和機場相連的建築」。towel（毛巾）、cough（咳嗽）、fever（發燒）都不能和建築物相連。
a hotel where they can rest「可以休息的旅館」，where 引導的子句說明是住宿的地方。soup（湯）、candle（蠟燭）、sugar（糖）都不能讓人在裡面休息。
on our trip to Australia「在去澳洲的旅程中」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、spoon（湯匙）都不能和 to Australia 組成旅程。
held up our passports「舉起我們的護照」，提醒弟弟還要搭飛機出國。coughs、lemons（檸檬）、socks（襪子）都和搭機無關。

passages.zh: 2025 年 4 月，新加坡樟宜機場在 Skytrax 世界機場大獎被評為「世界最佳機場」，從前一年得獎的杜哈哈馬德國際機場手中奪回第一名。樟宜出名的不只是航班。在和機場相連的「星耀樟宜」裡，有世界最高的室內瀑布，四周環繞著樹木和花園。旅客還能找到電影院、蝴蝶園，甚至有一家讓人在轉機空檔休息的旅館。去年夏天，我們家在去澳洲的途中在新加坡轉機。我們要等七個小時，卻一點也不無聊。我弟弟想一直待在瀑布旁邊，他問：「我們可以不去澳洲，住在這裡嗎？」媽媽笑著舉起我們的護照說：「抱歉，飛機不會等我們喔！」

passages.title: 哪一本護照最好用
passages.text: Every year, the Henley Passport Index ranks the {1} of the world. It counts how many places a person can visit without getting a visa first. In 2025, Singapore's passport was number one again. Its holders could visit about 190 places without a visa. Taiwan's passport was also quite strong, and Taiwanese travelers could enter well over 130 places without one. This makes planning a {2} much easier. Last year, my aunt went on a {3} of Europe. She visited five countries in two weeks, and she didn't need a visa for any of them. At every {4}, she only had to show her passport and answer a few questions. "The hardest part was carrying my heavy bags up the stairs of old {5}," she said. "Some of them had no elevator!"

blanks.why: ranks the passports of the world「替世界各國的護照排名」，這是護照指數。towels（毛巾）、soups（湯）、candles（蠟燭）都不能用免簽數量排名。
planning a trip「規劃旅行」。fever（發燒）、lemon（檸檬）、sock（襪子）都不需要事先「規劃」去國外。
went on a tour of Europe「去歐洲旅遊」，tour 是巡迴多地的旅行。cough（咳嗽）、sugar（糖）、pumpkin（南瓜）都不能和 go on a … of Europe 搭配。
At every airport「在每一個機場」都要出示護照。spoon（湯匙）、blanket（毯子）、soup 都不是入境檢查的地方。
the stairs of old hotels「老旅館的樓梯」，後面說有些沒有電梯。fevers（發燒）、coughs（咳嗽）、lemons（檸檬）都不是有樓梯和電梯的建築。

passages.zh: 每年，「亨利護照指數」都會替世界各國的護照排名，計算持有人不需要事先申請簽證就能前往多少地方。2025 年，新加坡護照再度排名第一，持有人大約能免簽前往 190 個地方。台灣護照也相當好用，台灣旅客可以免簽進入 130 多個地方，讓規劃旅行容易得多。去年，我阿姨去歐洲旅遊，兩週內玩了五個國家，每一國都不需要簽證。在每個機場，她只要出示護照、回答幾個問題就好。她說：「最辛苦的是提著行李箱爬老旅館的樓梯，有些根本沒有電梯！」

passages.title: 每天限四千人的富士山
passages.text: Mount Fuji is Japan's highest mountain, about 3,776 meters tall, and climbing it is a dream for many tourists. But in recent years, the trails became so crowded that some climbers rushed to the top without proper gear or rest. To solve the problem, Yamanashi Prefecture started new rules in 2024 for the Yoshida Trail, the most popular path. Only 4,000 climbers can start on that trail each day, and in 2025 the fee became 4,000 yen per person. Many climbers now book their {1} online and stay in a mountain {2}, called a hut, before they climb to see the sunrise. My uncle climbed it last summer on a group {3}. He flew into Haneda, a big {4} in Tokyo, and took a bus to the mountain. He said the hardest part was the cold wind at night, but watching the sun rise above the clouds made the whole {5} worth it.

blanks.why: book their trip online「在網路上預訂行程」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、towel（毛巾）都不能「預訂」來登山。
stay in a mountain hotel「住在山上的旅館」，後面說這種旅館叫做山屋（hut）。cough（咳嗽）、lemon（檸檬）、candle（蠟燭）都不能住在裡面。
on a group tour「跟團旅行」，group tour 是團體旅遊。fever（發燒）、spoon（湯匙）、blanket（毯子）都不能和 group 組成旅遊方式。
Haneda, a big airport in Tokyo「東京的大機場羽田」，前面用 flew into（搭機抵達）。sugar（糖）、pumpkin（南瓜）、cough（咳嗽）都不是飛機降落的地點。
made the whole trip worth it「讓整趟旅程都值得」。soup、candle、sock 都不能用 whole … worth it 來形容登山經驗。

passages.zh: 富士山是日本最高的山，大約 3,776 公尺高，攀登富士山是許多觀光客的夢想。但近幾年步道變得非常擁擠，有些登山客沒帶適當裝備、也沒休息就衝上山頂。為了解決問題，山梨縣從 2024 年起替最熱門的吉田路線訂了新規定：每天只能有 4,000 人從這條路線出發，2025 年起每人的費用變成 4,000 日圓。現在很多登山客會先在網路上預訂行程，在攻頂看日出前住在山上的旅館，也就是「山屋」。我叔叔去年夏天跟團去爬富士山。他飛到東京羽田機場，再搭巴士到山下。他說最辛苦的是夜裡的寒風，但看到太陽從雲海上升起，讓整趟旅程都值得了。

passages.title: 世界最高的飯店
passages.text: In November 2025, a new {1} opened in Dubai, and Guinness World Records named it the tallest hotel in the world. Ciel Dubai Marina is about 377 meters tall, and it has more than 1,000 rooms and suites. Near the top, there is a swimming pool with a view over the sea and the city. Guests can see the famous Palm Jumeirah island from their windows. Many people from other countries come to Dubai on business or on {2} of the Middle East, and the city wants to give them new reasons to visit. My classmate's family stopped in Dubai on a {3} to Europe last month. They didn't stay at that hotel because it was too expensive, but they took photos of it from the beach. When they got back to the {4}, my classmate bought a small {5} shaped like a tall tower for her little sister. Now it stands on her sister's desk next to a photo of Taipei 101.

blanks.why: a new hotel opened「一家新飯店開幕」，後面說它是世界最高的飯店。spoon（湯匙）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不會「開幕」並有一千多間客房。
on tours of the Middle East「到中東旅遊」，on business or on tours 是出差或旅遊。soups（湯）、candles（蠟燭）、lemons（檸檬）都不是來杜拜的原因。
on a trip to Europe「去歐洲的旅途中」。cough（咳嗽）、towel（毛巾）、blanket（毯子）都不能和 to Europe 組成旅程。
got back to the airport「回到機場」準備搭機離開。sugar（糖）、pumpkin（南瓜）、fever 都不是旅客要回去搭飛機的地方。
bought a small gift「買了一個小禮物」送妹妹。cough（咳嗽）、soup（湯）、sock（襪子）都不會做成高塔的形狀放在桌上。

passages.zh: 2025 年 11 月，杜拜有一家新飯店開幕，金氏世界紀錄認定它是全世界最高的飯店。杜拜濱海 Ciel 飯店大約 377 公尺高，有一千多間客房和套房。靠近頂樓有一座游泳池，可以俯瞰大海和城市。住客從窗戶就能看到有名的朱美拉棕櫚島。很多外國人來杜拜出差或到中東旅遊，杜拜也想給他們更多造訪的理由。我同學一家上個月去歐洲的途中在杜拜停留。他們沒有住那家飯店，因為太貴了，但他們在海灘上拍了它的照片。回到機場後，我同學買了一個高塔造型的小禮物送給妹妹。現在它就放在妹妹的書桌上，旁邊是一張台北 101 的照片。

passages.title: 為什麼會有時差
passages.text: When you fly across many time zones, you may feel tired in the day and wide awake at night. This is called jet lag. Your body has an inner clock that tells you when to sleep, eat, and wake up. After a long {1}, that clock is still on your home time, so it doesn't match the new place. Many people find that flying east is harder than flying west, because it is harder to go to bed earlier than usual than to stay up later. Doctors say sunlight is one of the best ways to reset your inner clock. So after you check in at your {2}, try to go outside in the daylight instead of taking a long nap. Last summer, my family took a {3} of the United States. On the first day, my sister fell asleep in the {4} while we waited for our bags. She even slept through dinner on our first night in the {5}!

blanks.why: after a long trip「長途旅行之後」，生理時鐘還停留在家鄉時間。fever（發燒）、soup（湯）、cough（咳嗽）都不會讓人跨越時區。
check in at your hotel「在飯店辦理入住」，check in 是住房登記。lemon（檸檬）、towel（毛巾）、sock（襪子）都不能辦理入住。
took a tour of the United States「去美國旅遊」，take a tour of + 地方。candle（蠟燭）、spoon（湯匙）、pumpkin（南瓜）都不能用來遊覽一個國家。
fell asleep in the airport「在機場睡著」，正在等行李。sugar（糖）、blanket（毯子）、cough 都不是等行李的地方。
our first night in the hotel「在飯店的第一晚」。soup、fever、sock 都不是過夜的地方。

passages.zh: 當你搭飛機跨越很多個時區時，可能會白天很累、晚上卻很清醒，這叫做「時差」。身體裡有一個生理時鐘，告訴你什麼時候該睡、該吃、該起床。長途旅行之後，這個時鐘還停在家鄉的時間，所以和新的地方對不上。很多人覺得往東飛比往西飛更難適應，因為要比平常早睡，比晚睡更困難。醫生說，陽光是調整生理時鐘最好的方法之一。所以在飯店辦好入住後，試著到戶外曬曬太陽，而不是睡一場長長的午覺。去年夏天，我們家去美國旅遊。第一天，我妹妹在機場等行李時就睡著了。她甚至在飯店的第一晚睡過了晚餐時間！

passages.title: 跑道上的大數字
passages.text: Have you ever looked out of a plane window and seen big white numbers at the end of a runway? Those numbers are not random. They show the compass direction of the runway. A circle has 360 degrees, so pilots drop the last zero. A runway pointing east, at 90 degrees, is called "09." If you look at the same runway from the other end, it points west, at 270 degrees, so it is called "27." That's why every {1} runway has two numbers, one at each end. Because Earth's magnetic north slowly moves, some {2} even have to change their runway numbers after many years. On our family {3} to Japan, I sat by the window and saw "34" painted on the runway. Then I opened a {4} app on my phone and found that we were heading almost north. After we got to the {5}, I told my parents everything I had learned. They were not as excited as I was.

blanks.why: every airport runway「每一座機場的跑道」，airport 修飾 runway。soup（湯）、fever（發燒）、cough（咳嗽）都沒有跑道。
some airports have to change their numbers「有些機場得更改跑道編號」。spoons（湯匙）、socks（襪子）、lemons（檸檬）都沒有跑道編號。
our family trip to Japan「我們家去日本的旅行」。towel（毛巾）、sugar（糖）、candle（蠟燭）都不能和 family … to Japan 組成旅程。
opened a map app「打開地圖 App」查看方向。cough、blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）都不是手機上看方向的 App。
got to the hotel「到了飯店」。fever、spoon、soup 都不是旅途中下榻的地方。

passages.zh: 你有沒有從飛機窗戶往外看，看到跑道盡頭寫著大大的白色數字？那些數字不是隨便寫的，它們代表跑道的羅盤方向。一圈是 360 度，飛行員會把最後一個零省略。朝東、也就是 90 度的跑道叫做「09」。從同一條跑道的另一端看，它朝西、是 270 度，所以叫「27」。這就是為什麼每座機場的跑道兩端都有一個號碼。因為地球的磁北極會慢慢移動，有些機場過了很多年甚至得更改跑道編號。我們家去日本旅行時，我坐在窗邊，看到跑道上漆著「34」。接著我打開手機的地圖 App，發現我們幾乎是朝北方前進。到了飯店，我把學到的東西全告訴爸媽，可是他們沒有我那麼興奮。

passages.title: 飛機上的飯為什麼比較淡
passages.text: Have you ever noticed that food on a {1} doesn't taste as good as it does on the ground? It's not only the cook's fault. A study for the airline Lufthansa found that in a plane's dry air and low pressure, our sense of taste for salty and sweet foods drops by about 30 percent. Our noses also get dry, and smell is a big part of taste. Loud engine noise may make some flavors weaker, too. Interestingly, tomato juice tastes better in the air, so many people order it only on {2}. Because of this, airline cooks often add more salt and spices to the meals. On my last {3} to Thailand, I tried tomato juice on the plane for the first time. It was delicious! But when I ordered it again at our {4}, it tasted strange. "Maybe it only works at 10,000 meters," my dad laughed. On the way home, I bought a can at the {5} and drank it on the plane. My dad was right.

blanks.why: food on a plane「飛機上的食物」，整篇在講機上餐點。sofa（沙發）、candle（蠟燭）、drawer（抽屜）都不能載人在高空吃飯。
order it only on planes「只在飛機上點番茄汁」，因為它在空中比較好喝。towels（毛巾）、coughs（咳嗽）、soups（湯）都不是可以點飲料的地方。
my last trip to Thailand「我上次去泰國的旅行」。soup（湯）、cough（咳嗽）、fever（發燒）都不能和 to Thailand 組成旅程。
ordered it again at our hotel「在我們的飯店又點了一次」。sock（襪子）、sugar（糖）、towel（毛巾）都不是可以點飲料的地方。
bought a can at the airport「在機場買了一罐」，回程搭機前買的。lemon（檸檬）、candle（蠟燭）、spoon（湯匙）都不是商店或地點。

passages.zh: 你有沒有發現，飛機上的食物吃起來沒有在地面上好吃？這不只是廚師的錯。一項替德國漢莎航空做的研究發現，在機艙乾燥的空氣和低氣壓中，我們對鹹味和甜味的感覺會下降大約三成。我們的鼻子也會變乾，而嗅覺是味道很重要的一部分。引擎的噪音可能也會讓某些味道變淡。有趣的是，番茄汁在空中反而比較好喝，所以很多人只在飛機上點它。因為這樣，航空公司的廚師常常在餐點裡多加鹽和香料。上次我去泰國旅行時，第一次在飛機上喝番茄汁，覺得超好喝！但在飯店再點一次時，味道卻很奇怪。爸爸笑著說：「也許它只有在一萬公尺高才好喝。」回程時，我在機場買了一罐帶上飛機喝。爸爸說對了。

passages.title: 不吃不睡飛十一天的斑尾鷸
passages.text: In October 2022, a young bar-tailed godwit set a world record. The bird was only five months old. It left Alaska on October 13 and flew south over the Pacific Ocean. It did not stop to eat, drink, or rest. Eleven days later, it landed in Tasmania, an island south of Australia. The {1} was about 13,560 kilometers long, the longest nonstop flight ever recorded for a bird. Scientists knew this because the bird carried a tiny tracker, like a little {2} that told everyone where it had been. Before such a long flight, godwits eat a lot and get very fat, and some of their body parts even get smaller to make room for fuel. My family took a {3} to Australia last year. Our flight from Taipei took about nine hours, and when we got off the {4} at the {5}, I was already tired. I can't imagine flying for eleven days without a break!

blanks.why: The trip was about 13,560 kilometers long「這趟旅程大約 13,560 公里」。fever（發燒）、soup（湯）、sugar（糖）都不能用公里數來形容。
like a little passport「像一本小護照」，比喻追蹤器記錄了牠去過哪裡。cough（咳嗽）、towel（毛巾）、lemon（檸檬）都不能記錄旅行的地點。
took a trip to Australia「去澳洲旅行」，take a trip 是固定用法。candle（蠟燭）、spoon（湯匙）、sock（襪子）都不能和 take a … to 地點 搭配。
got off the plane「下飛機」。blanket（毯子）、sofa（沙發）、pumpkin（南瓜）都不能搭乘九小時。
at the airport「在機場」下飛機。sugar、cough、fever 都不是飛機降落的地方。

passages.zh: 2022 年 10 月，一隻年輕的斑尾鷸創下世界紀錄。這隻鳥才五個月大。牠在 10 月 13 日離開阿拉斯加，往南飛越太平洋，途中沒有停下來吃東西、喝水或休息。十一天後，牠降落在澳洲南邊的島嶼塔斯馬尼亞。這趟旅程大約 13,560 公里，是有紀錄以來鳥類最長的不停歇飛行。科學家會知道，是因為這隻鳥身上帶著一個小小的追蹤器，就像一本記錄牠去過哪裡的小護照。斑尾鷸在長途飛行前會大吃特吃、變得很胖，有些身體器官甚至會縮小，好空出位置存放「燃料」。我們家去年去澳洲旅行，從台北飛過去大約九個小時，在機場下飛機時我就已經累壞了。我無法想像連續飛十一天都不休息！

passages.title: 一輩子飛到月球三趟的北極燕鷗
passages.text: The Arctic tern is a small seabird that weighs only about 100 grams, but it takes the longest yearly {1} of any animal. It spends summer in the far north, near the Arctic, and then flies all the way to the Antarctic for the summer in the south. In 2010, scientists put tiny trackers on some terns. They found that one bird could fly about 70,000 kilometers in a year! Over its whole life, a tern may fly more than two million kilometers. That's like flying to the moon and back about three times. The birds don't need a {2} or an {3}. They rest on the water and catch fish on the way. My grandpa loves birds, and he once went on a bird-watching {4} in Iceland. He saw thousands of Arctic terns there. He said they were brave, too. When he walked too close to their nests, they flew down at his head! He still keeps the {5} he took that day on his wall.

blanks.why: the longest yearly trip「每年最長的旅程」，燕鷗每年往返南北極。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能用來比較長度。
don't need a hotel「不需要旅館」，牠們在水上休息。cough（咳嗽）、lemon（檸檬）、spoon（湯匙）都不是旅行時住的地方。
or an airport「也不需要機場」，因為牠們自己會飛。towel（毛巾）、candle（蠟燭）、sugar（糖）都不是起降的地方。
a bird-watching tour「賞鳥行程」，tour 是有安排的旅遊。fever、blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）都不能和 bird-watching 組成旅遊活動。
keeps the photo he took「留著他拍的照片」，take a photo 是拍照。cough、sugar、soup 都不能「拍」也不能掛在牆上。

passages.zh: 北極燕鷗是一種體重只有大約一百公克的小海鳥，卻是所有動物裡每年旅程最長的。牠在遙遠北方的北極附近過夏天，接著一路飛到南極，在南半球再過一次夏天。2010 年，科學家在一些燕鷗身上裝了小小的追蹤器，發現一隻燕鷗一年可以飛大約七萬公里！一輩子下來，一隻燕鷗可能飛超過兩百萬公里，相當於飛到月球再回來大約三趟。這些鳥不需要旅館，也不需要機場，牠們在水面上休息，邊飛邊捕魚。我爺爺很喜歡鳥，他曾經參加冰島的賞鳥行程，在那裡看到好幾千隻北極燕鷗。他說牠們也很勇敢：他走得太靠近鳥巢時，牠們就俯衝到他頭上！他到現在還把那天拍的照片掛在牆上。

passages.title: 每年都會融化的冰旅館
passages.text: In Jukkasjärvi, a small village in northern Sweden, there is a {1} made almost completely of ice and snow. It is called the Icehotel, and since 1989, it has been built again every winter with ice from the nearby Torne River. In spring, most of it melts and flows back into the river. Each year, artists from around the world design new rooms, so no two years look the same. Inside, the temperature stays around minus five degrees. Guests sleep in warm sleeping bags on beds made of ice, covered with reindeer skins. Many visitors come on winter {2} to see the northern lights, too. My aunt stayed there for one night on her {3} to Sweden. She flew into a small {4} near the village. She said the room was beautiful but so cold that she wore her hat to bed. In the morning, the staff brought her a cup of hot lingonberry juice. "It was the best {5} I have ever had," she said.

blanks.why: a hotel made of ice and snow「用冰雪做成的旅館」，後面說它叫 Icehotel。soup（湯）、sugar（糖）、cough（咳嗽）都不能讓人住宿。
come on winter tours「參加冬季旅遊團來」，順便看北極光。lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）、spoons（湯匙）都不能「參加」來旅遊。
on her trip to Sweden「在她去瑞典的旅途中」。towel（毛巾）、fever（發燒）、sock（襪子）都不能和 to Sweden 組成旅程。
flew into a small airport「搭飛機抵達一座小機場」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、cough 都不是飛機降落的地方。
the best juice I have ever had「我喝過最棒的果汁」，指熱越橘汁。sock（襪子）、cough（咳嗽）、towel（毛巾）都不能喝。

passages.zh: 在瑞典北部的小村莊尤卡斯耶爾維，有一家幾乎全用冰雪做成的旅館，叫做「冰旅館」。從 1989 年起，它每年冬天都會用附近托爾訥河的冰重新蓋一次。到了春天，大部分會融化，流回河裡。每年都有來自世界各地的藝術家設計新的房間，所以每一年的樣子都不一樣。裡面的溫度一直維持在零下五度左右。住客睡在冰做的床上，鋪著馴鹿皮，再鑽進溫暖的睡袋。很多遊客參加冬季旅遊團來這裡，也順便看北極光。我阿姨去瑞典旅行時在那裡住了一晚。她搭飛機到村莊附近的一座小機場。她說房間很漂亮，但冷到她戴著帽子睡覺。早上，工作人員送來一杯熱越橘汁。她說：「那是我喝過最棒的果汁。」

passages.title: 拿下第四座環法冠軍的波加查
passages.text: The Tour de France is the most famous bike race in the world. Every July, riders race for about 3,300 kilometers over three weeks, through cities, farms, and high mountains in France. In 2025, Tadej Pogačar from Slovenia won the {1} for the fourth time. He had also won in 2020, 2021, and 2024. On the last day, the riders came into Paris and climbed the steep streets of Montmartre before finishing on the Champs-Élysées. Thousands of fans followed the riders from town to town. Some camped by the road, and others stayed in small {2} in the mountains for days. My uncle loves cycling, and last summer he went on a {3} to France just to watch one mountain stage. He landed at the {4} in Nice, rode a bike up the mountain, and waited for hours. "The riders went past me in ten seconds," he said, "but it was the best part of my {5} of France!"

blanks.why: won the tour for the fourth time「第四度贏得環法賽」，Tour de France 也可以簡稱 the tour。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不是可以「贏得」的比賽。
stayed in small hotels「住在小旅館」。coughs（咳嗽）、lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）都不能住人。
went on a trip to France「去法國旅行」。towel（毛巾）、spoon（湯匙）、sugar（糖）都不能和 go on a … to 地點 搭配。
landed at the airport in Nice「在尼斯的機場降落」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不是飛機降落的地方。
my tour of France「我的法國之旅」，tour of + 地方是「在某地四處遊覽」。cough、fever、sock 都不能和 of France 組成旅程。

passages.zh: 環法自行車賽是全世界最有名的自行車比賽。每年七月，選手要在三週內騎大約 3,300 公里，經過法國的城市、農田和高山。2025 年，來自斯洛維尼亞的塔德伊‧波加查第四度拿下環法冠軍，他之前也在 2020、2021 和 2024 年奪冠。最後一天，選手騎進巴黎，爬上蒙馬特陡峭的街道，最後在香榭麗舍大道衝線。成千上萬的車迷跟著選手從一個城鎮到另一個城鎮，有些人在路邊露營，有些人在山區的小旅館住了好幾天。我叔叔很喜歡騎自行車，去年夏天他只為了看一個山區賽段就跑去法國。他在尼斯的機場降落，騎腳踏車上山，等了好幾個小時。他說：「選手十秒鐘就從我面前騎過去了，但那是我這趟法國之旅最棒的部分！」

passages.title: 戰鬥機護送回國的羽球金牌
passages.text: At the Paris 2024 Olympics, Taiwan's badminton pair Lee Yang and Wang Chi-lin won the gold medal in men's doubles. They had also won in Tokyo in 2021, so they became the first men's doubles pair to win two Olympic golds in a row. When their {1} home began, Taiwan's air force sent fighter jets to fly next to their plane as it came into Taiwan. Hundreds of fans waited at Taoyuan {2} with flags and signs. Some of them had arrived hours early just to say thank you. That night, many people in Taiwan watched the news on TV and cheered again. My cousin was at the airport, too. She said the players looked tired from the long {3}, but they smiled and waved at everyone. She even got close enough to take a {4}. Now our school {5} club has that photo on the wall.

blanks.why: their trip home began「他們踏上回國的旅程」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、sugar（糖）都不能和 home 組成回家的旅程。
waited at Taoyuan airport「在桃園機場等待」，選手搭飛機回國。cough（咳嗽）、towel（毛巾）、candle（蠟燭）都不是接機的地方。
tired from the long trip「因為長途旅行而疲累」。fever（發燒）、spoon（湯匙）、lemon（檸檬）都不能用 long 形容並讓人疲累到需要休息。
take a photo「拍照」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不能「拍」。
our school badminton club「學校羽球社」，文章在講羽球。cough、fever、sock 都不是運動項目。

passages.zh: 在 2024 年巴黎奧運，台灣的羽球組合李洋和王齊麟拿下男子雙打金牌。他們在 2021 年的東京奧運也奪冠，成為第一對奧運連霸的男子雙打組合。他們踏上回國的旅程時，台灣空軍派出戰鬥機，在他們的飛機進入台灣時一路伴飛。好幾百名球迷拿著國旗和標語在桃園機場等待，有些人提早好幾個小時到，只為了說聲謝謝。那天晚上，很多台灣人看電視新聞，又歡呼了一次。我表姊當時也在機場。她說選手們看起來因為長途旅行有點累，但還是對大家微笑揮手。她甚至靠得夠近，拍到了一張照片。現在我們學校的羽球社把那張照片貼在牆上。

passages.title: 大聯盟開幕戰飛到東京
passages.text: On March 18 and 19, 2025, the Los Angeles Dodgers and the Chicago Cubs started the Major League Baseball season in Japan. The games were played at the Tokyo Dome. Both teams made the long {1} across the Pacific Ocean, and fans in Japan were very excited because many Japanese stars were playing, including Shohei Ohtani and Yoshinobu Yamamoto. In the first game, Yamamoto pitched well and the Dodgers won 4-1. In the second game, Ohtani hit a home run, and the crowd went wild. Tickets were very hard to get, and {2} near the stadium were full for days. When the Dodgers arrived at the {3} in Tokyo, crowds of fans were already waiting with cameras. My cousin in Japan didn't get a ticket, but he went to a sports bar near the stadium with his {4}. He said the cheering there was so loud that it felt like watching the game in the {5} itself.

blanks.why: made the long trip「長途跋涉」，兩隊飛越太平洋。soup（湯）、sugar（糖）、sock（襪子）都不能和 make the long … across 搭配。
hotels near the stadium were full「球場附近的飯店都客滿」。coughs（咳嗽）、fevers（發燒）、lemons（檸檬）都不會「客滿」。
arrived at the airport in Tokyo「抵達東京的機場」，球隊搭機飛來。towel（毛巾）、candle（蠟燭）、spoon（湯匙）都不是抵達的地點。
with his classmates「和他的同學」一起去。sugars、soups、socks 都不能和人一起去運動酒吧。
in the park itself「就在球場裡」，棒球場也可以叫 ballpark 或 park。cough（咳嗽）、pumpkin（南瓜）、blanket（毯子）都不是看比賽的地方。

passages.zh: 2025 年 3 月 18 日和 19 日，洛杉磯道奇隊和芝加哥小熊隊在日本揭開美國職棒大聯盟球季的序幕，比賽在東京巨蛋舉行。兩隊都飛越太平洋長途跋涉而來，日本球迷非常興奮，因為有很多日本球星上場，包括大谷翔平和山本由伸。第一場比賽，山本投得很好，道奇以 4 比 1 獲勝。第二場比賽，大谷擊出全壘打，全場觀眾都瘋了。門票非常難買，球場附近的飯店連續好幾天都客滿。道奇隊抵達東京的機場時，已經有大批拿著相機的球迷在等。我住在日本的表哥沒買到票，但他和同學去了球場附近的運動酒吧。他說那裡的歡呼聲大到感覺就像在球場裡看球一樣。

passages.title: Faker 在倫敦拿下第五座世界冠軍
passages.text: On November 2, 2024, the Korean team T1 won the League of Legends World Championship at the O2 Arena in London. They beat China's Bilibili Gaming 3-2 in a very close final. For T1's star player Faker, it was his fifth world title, more than any other player in the game's history. He was also named the most valuable player of the final. Thousands of fans made the {1} to London to watch the match. Some flew in from Asia, and many {2} near the arena were full. The championship is also a kind of world {3}, because it is held in a different country almost every year. My older brother loves the game. He stayed up all night to watch the final online, and when T1 won, he jumped up and woke the whole family. He says that one day he will fly to the world final himself, so he is already saving money for the plane ticket and a {4}. My mom says he should save some time for his {5}, too.

blanks.why: made the trip to London「專程到倫敦」，make the trip 是「跑一趟」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能和 make the … to London 搭配。
many hotels were full「很多飯店都客滿了」。lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）、spoons（湯匙）都不會客滿。
a kind of world tour「一種世界巡迴」，因為每年幾乎在不同國家舉辦。cough（咳嗽）、sugar（糖）、towel（毛巾）都不能和 world 組成「巡迴」的意思。
saving money for a passport「存錢辦護照」，出國需要護照。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不是出國要準備的證件。
save some time for his homework「留點時間寫作業」。cough、fever、sock 都不需要花時間完成。

passages.zh: 2024 年 11 月 2 日，韓國戰隊 T1 在倫敦的 O2 體育館拿下《英雄聯盟》世界大賽冠軍。他們在一場非常膠著的決賽中，以 3 比 2 擊敗中國的 BLG。對 T1 的明星選手 Faker 來說，這是他的第五座世界冠軍，比這款遊戲史上任何一位選手都多，他也拿下決賽最有價值選手。成千上萬名粉絲專程到倫敦看比賽，有些人從亞洲飛過去，體育館附近很多飯店都客滿了。這項冠軍賽也算是一種世界巡迴，因為它幾乎每年都在不同的國家舉辦。我哥哥很愛這款遊戲。他熬了一整夜在網路上看決賽，T1 贏的時候，他跳起來把全家都吵醒了。他說有一天他要親自飛去看世界決賽，所以已經開始存錢買機票、辦護照。媽媽說他也應該留點時間寫作業。

passages.title: 球后曾雅妮的巡迴賽人生
passages.text: Yani Tseng was born in Taoyuan in 1989, and she started playing golf when she was a child. In 2008, she began playing on the LPGA Tour, the top golf {1} for women in the world. Playing on the tour means traveling almost every week. Players fly from one {2} to another and spend many nights in {3} in different countries. In 2011, at just 22 years old, Tseng became the youngest golfer, man or woman, to win five major championships. That year, she also became the world's number one woman golfer, and she stayed at the top for 109 weeks in a row. Many young golfers in Taiwan started playing because of her. My dad watched her play once when he was on a business {4} in the United States. He still keeps the ticket in his {5} like a treasure.

blanks.why: the top golf tour for women「頂尖的女子高爾夫巡迴賽」，tour 指在各地輪流舉行的系列賽。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不是高爾夫賽事。
fly from one airport to another「從一座機場飛到另一座」。cough（咳嗽）、lemon（檸檬）、candle（蠟燭）都不是搭飛機出發的地方。
spend many nights in hotels「在飯店過很多夜」。towels（毛巾）、spoons（湯匙）、sugars（糖）都不能住人。
on a business trip「出差」，business trip 是因公旅行。soup、fever（發燒）、blanket（毯子）都不能和 business 組成「出差」。
keeps the ticket in his wallet「把票根放在皮夾裡」。cough、pumpkin（南瓜）、sock（襪子）都不是收票根的地方。

gloss: 美國女子職業高爾夫協會
passages.zh: 曾雅妮在 1989 年出生於桃園，從小就開始打高爾夫球。2008 年，她加入全世界頂尖的女子高爾夫巡迴賽 LPGA。在巡迴賽打球，代表幾乎每週都要移動。選手從一座機場飛到另一座機場，在不同國家的飯店過很多夜。2011 年，年僅 22 歲的曾雅妮成為史上最年輕拿下五座大滿貫的高爾夫球員，不分男女。那一年，她也成為世界球后，並連續 109 週保持第一。台灣很多年輕球員就是因為她才開始打球。我爸爸有一次去美國出差時看過她比賽，他到現在還把那張票根像寶物一樣放在皮夾裡。

passages.title: 奧運選手村的紙板床
passages.text: At the Paris 2024 Olympics, athletes stayed in the Olympic Village, a group of new buildings that worked like a giant {1} for more than 14,000 people. Their beds were made of cardboard! The beds were first used at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021, and Paris used them again because they can be recycled after the Games. Some people joked that the beds would break easily, so a few athletes made videos of themselves jumping on them to show they were strong. For many athletes, the Olympics is a long {2} far from home. They pack their bags, show their {3} at the airport, and fly halfway around the world. My cousin plays table tennis, and she went to a big youth tournament abroad last year. She said the {4} beds there were soft and normal, but she still couldn't sleep the night before her first {5}.

blanks.why: worked like a giant hotel「就像一座巨大的旅館」，讓選手住宿。soup（湯）、cough（咳嗽）、fever（發燒）都不能讓一萬多人住。
a long trip far from home「離家很遠的長途旅行」。sock（襪子）、sugar（糖）、lemon（檸檬）都不能用 far from home 來形容。
show their passports at the airport「在機場出示護照」。towels（毛巾）、candles（蠟燭）、spoons（湯匙）都不是出國要出示的證件。
the hotel beds「飯店的床」，她比賽時住飯店。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不能修飾 beds 表示住宿地點。
the night before her first match「她第一場比賽的前一晚」。cough、fever、sock 都不是比賽。

passages.zh: 在 2024 年巴黎奧運，選手住在奧運選手村，這是一群新建的大樓，就像一座能住一萬四千多人的巨大旅館。他們的床竟然是用紙板做的！這種床最早在 2021 年的東京奧運使用，巴黎再次採用，因為比賽結束後可以回收。有人開玩笑說這種床很容易壞，所以有幾位選手拍影片，在床上跳來跳去，證明它很堅固。對很多選手來說，奧運是一趟離家很遠的長途旅行：他們打包行李、在機場出示護照，飛越大半個地球。我表姊打桌球，去年她到國外參加一場大型青少年錦標賽。她說那裡飯店的床又軟又普通，但她第一場比賽的前一晚還是睡不著。

passages.title: 全女性機組的太空旅行
passages.text: On April 14, 2025, a Blue Origin rocket called New Shepard took six women to the edge of space from West Texas. It was the first spaceflight with an all-female crew since 1963, when Valentina Tereshkova of the Soviet Union flew into space alone. The crew included singer Katy Perry, TV host Gayle King, and Aisha Bowe, a former NASA rocket scientist. Another member, Amanda Nguyen, works to protect the rights of women who have been hurt. The whole {1} lasted only about 11 minutes. The women floated for a few minutes and looked down at Earth before the capsule came back down with parachutes. Some people said it was more like an expensive {2} than real science, while others said it helped girls see that space is for them, too. My cousin dreams of becoming a pilot. When she watched the video, she said, "One day, I want to take a {3} like that!" She has already made a {4} of every space center in the world, and she says the first one she will visit is near the {5} in Houston.

blanks.why: The whole trip lasted about 11 minutes「整趟旅程大約 11 分鐘」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能「持續」11 分鐘飛上太空。
more like an expensive tour「比較像昂貴的觀光行程」，有人這樣評論。cough（咳嗽）、lemon（檸檬）、towel（毛巾）都不能和 real science 比較。
take a trip like that「來一趟那樣的旅行」，take a trip 是固定用法。candle（蠟燭）、sugar（糖）、spoon（湯匙）都不能和 take a … like that 搭配。
made a map of every space center「畫了一張世界各地太空中心的地圖」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不能標出地點。
near the airport in Houston「在休士頓的機場附近」。cough、fever、sock 都不是地點。

passages.zh: 2025 年 4 月 14 日，藍色起源公司的「新雪帕德」火箭從德州西部載著六位女性飛到太空邊緣。這是自 1963 年蘇聯的范倫蒂娜‧泰勒斯可娃獨自飛上太空以來，第一次全由女性組成的太空飛行。成員包括歌手凱蒂‧佩芮、電視主持人蓋兒‧金，以及曾在美國太空總署擔任火箭科學家的艾莎‧鮑。另一位成員阿曼達‧阮致力於保護受傷害女性的權利。整趟旅程只有大約 11 分鐘。她們漂浮了幾分鐘、俯瞰地球，接著太空艙就靠降落傘落回地面。有人說這比較像昂貴的觀光行程而不是真正的科學，也有人說它讓女孩們看到太空也屬於她們。我表姊夢想當飛行員。看完影片，她說：「總有一天，我也要來一趟那樣的旅行！」她已經畫了一張全世界太空中心的地圖，還說她要去的第一個地方就在休士頓的機場附近。

passages.title: 跨國同婚可以登記了
passages.text: In 2019, Taiwan became the first place in Asia to allow same-sex marriage. But at first, there was a problem. If a Taiwanese person wanted to marry someone of the same sex from a country where same-sex marriage was not legal, they could not register their marriage. Some couples had to live apart, and they could only see each other on short {1}. In January 2023, the Ministry of the Interior changed the rule, and many of these couples were finally able to register. News reports showed couples holding their {2} and marriage papers with big smiles. My teacher's friend was one of them. Her partner is from Japan, and for years they met only at the {3} or in {4} when she visited. After the rule changed, they had a small wedding in Taipei. My teacher showed us a {5} of them and said, "Love doesn't stop at borders."

blanks.why: short trips「短暫的旅行」，只能在探訪時見面。soups（湯）、socks（襪子）、fevers（發燒）都不能讓人見面。
holding their passports「拿著他們的護照」，外籍伴侶登記時需要身分證件。lemons（檸檬）、towels（毛巾）、candles（蠟燭）都不是登記結婚要帶的文件。
met only at the airport「只能在機場見面」，因為一方要搭飛機來台灣。sugar（糖）、cough（咳嗽）、spoon（湯匙）都不是見面的地點。
in hotels「在飯店」，來訪時住飯店。blankets（毯子）、pumpkins（南瓜）、soups 都不是可以見面住宿的地方。
showed us a photo「給我們看一張照片」。fever、sock、cough 都不能拿來給人看婚禮的樣子。

passages.zh: 2019 年，台灣成為亞洲第一個同性婚姻合法的地方。但一開始有個問題：如果台灣人想和來自同性婚姻不合法國家的同性伴侶結婚，就不能登記。有些伴侶只好分隔兩地，只能趁短暫的旅行見面。2023 年 1 月，內政部修改了規定，這些伴侶中很多人終於可以登記結婚。新聞畫面中，伴侶們拿著護照和結婚文件，笑得很開心。我老師的朋友就是其中一對。她的伴侶來自日本，好幾年來，她們只能在機場見面，或在對方來訪時住在飯店裡。規定改了之後，她們在台北辦了一場小小的婚禮。老師給我們看她們的照片，說：「愛不會在國界前停下來。」

passages.title: 向日葵掛繩的意思
passages.text: Some people have disabilities that you cannot see, such as autism, hearing loss, or anxiety. Busy places like airports can be very hard for them, because there are bright lights, loud noises, and long lines. In 2016, Gatwick, a big {1} in London, started giving out green lanyards with yellow sunflowers on them. Travelers can choose to wear one, and staff will understand that they may need more time or a little extra help. They don't have to explain why. Today, the sunflower is used at many {2} around the world, and also in some train stations, shops, and {3}. My cousin has autism, and long {4} used to scare him. On his last family trip, he wore a sunflower lanyard. A staff member saw it and kindly let his family go through a quieter line to show their {5}. "It was the best trip ever," he told me.

blanks.why: Gatwick, a big airport in London「倫敦的大機場蓋威克」，前面也提到機場這類忙碌的地方。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、lemon（檸檬）都不能發放掛繩給旅客。
used at many airports「在很多機場使用」。coughs（咳嗽）、fevers（發燒）、towels（毛巾）都不是地點。
shops, and hotels「商店和飯店」，都是公共場所。candles（蠟燭）、sugars（糖）、spoons（湯匙）都不是地點。
long trips used to scare him「長途旅行以前會讓他害怕」。blankets（毯子）、pumpkins（南瓜）、socks（襪子）都不會讓人害怕出門。
show their passports「出示護照」，出國過海關時要出示。soups（湯）、lemons（檸檬）、fevers 都不能出示通關。

passages.zh: 有些人的障礙是別人看不見的，例如自閉症、聽力損失或焦慮症。像機場這樣忙碌的地方對他們來說可能很難熬，因為有刺眼的燈光、很大的噪音和長長的隊伍。2016 年，倫敦蓋威克機場開始發放印有黃色向日葵的綠色掛繩。旅客可以自己選擇要不要戴，工作人員看到就會明白他們可能需要多一點時間或額外的協助，而且他們不必解釋原因。現在，全世界很多機場都使用向日葵標誌，一些火車站、商店和飯店也有。我表弟有自閉症，以前長途旅行會讓他很害怕。上次全家出遊時，他戴了向日葵掛繩。一位工作人員看到後，親切地讓他們全家走比較安靜的通道出示護照。他告訴我：「那是我最棒的一次旅行。」

passages.title: 七十二天環遊世界的女記者
passages.text: In 1889, a young American reporter named Nellie Bly decided to try something amazing. She wanted to travel around the world faster than the hero of Jules Verne's famous novel, who did it in 80 days. At that time, many people thought a woman should not travel alone. But on November 14, 1889, Bly started her {1} from New Jersey with only one small bag. She traveled by ship and train across Europe, through the Suez Canal, and on to Asia. She even met Jules Verne himself in France! Newspapers followed her {2} every day, and readers guessed when she would return. On January 25, 1890, she arrived back in New York after just 72 days, setting a world record. Her {3} of the world made her famous. Today, a {4} around the world can take less than two days by {5}. But I still think Nellie Bly's adventure was much more exciting.

blanks.why: started her trip「開始她的旅程」。soup（湯）、fever（發燒）、cough（咳嗽）都不能「出發」。
followed her trip every day「每天追蹤她的旅程」。sugar（糖）、towel（毛巾）、sock（襪子）都不是報紙會天天報導的事。
Her tour of the world「她的環球之旅」，tour of + 地方。spoon（湯匙）、lemon（檸檬）、candle（蠟燭）都不能讓人出名。
a trip around the world「一趟環遊世界的旅行」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不能「環遊世界」。
by plane「搭飛機」，by + 交通工具。sofa（沙發）、drawer（抽屜）、cough 都不是交通工具。

passages.zh: 1889 年，一位名叫奈莉‧布萊的年輕美國記者決定嘗試一件驚人的事：她想比凡爾納名著裡那位花了 80 天環遊世界的主角更快繞地球一圈。當時很多人認為女人不應該單獨旅行。但在 1889 年 11 月 14 日，布萊只帶著一個小包包，就從紐澤西出發了。她搭船和火車穿越歐洲、經過蘇伊士運河，再前往亞洲，甚至還在法國見到了凡爾納本人！報紙每天報導她的旅程，讀者紛紛猜她什麼時候會回來。1890 年 1 月 25 日，她只花了 72 天就回到紐約，創下世界紀錄。這趟環球之旅讓她一舉成名。今天，搭飛機環遊世界不用兩天就能完成，但我還是覺得奈莉‧布萊的冒險精彩多了。

passages.title: BLACKPINK 的「Born Pink」巡演
passages.text: From October 2022 to September 2023, BLACKPINK traveled the world on a {1} called Born Pink. They played 66 shows in Asia, North America, Europe, and Oceania, and every show was sold out. The {2} earned more money than any tour by a girl group in history, and it also became the highest-earning tour ever by an Asian act at that time. In March 2023, BLACKPINK performed two shows in Kaohsiung. Fans from all over Taiwan made the {3} south, and {4} near the stadium were fully booked weeks before. My cousin flew from Hong Kong to see them. When she landed at Kaohsiung {5}, she found many other fans in pink shirts. "We were strangers," she said, "but we sang their songs together all the way to the stadium."

blanks.why: traveled the world on a tour「展開世界巡迴」，on a tour 是「在巡迴中」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能帶人環遊世界。
The tour earned more money「這場巡演賺的錢更多」。cough（咳嗽）、towel（毛巾）、lemon（檸檬）都不能「賺錢」。
made the trip south「往南跑一趟」，粉絲從各地南下高雄。spoon（湯匙）、candle（蠟燭）、sugar（糖）都不能和 make the … south 搭配。
hotels were fully booked「飯店都被訂滿了」。blankets（毯子）、pumpkins（南瓜）、soups（湯）都不能預訂。
landed at Kaohsiung airport「降落在高雄機場」。fever（發燒）、sock（襪子）、cough 都不是飛機降落的地方。

passages.zh: 從 2022 年 10 月到 2023 年 9 月，BLACKPINK 展開「Born Pink 世界巡迴演唱會」。她們在亞洲、北美、歐洲和大洋洲唱了 66 場，每一場都賣光。這場巡演的收入超越史上所有女子團體的巡演，也成為當時亞洲歌手收入最高的巡演。2023 年 3 月，BLACKPINK 在高雄開了兩場演唱會。全台各地的粉絲紛紛南下，體育場附近的飯店好幾週前就被訂滿了。我表姊從香港飛來看。她在高雄機場降落時，看到很多穿著粉紅色衣服的粉絲。她說：「我們本來是陌生人，但一路唱著她們的歌走到體育場。」

passages.title: Jin 的第一次個人巡演
passages.text: On June 28 and 29, 2025, BTS member Jin started his first solo world {1} at Goyang Stadium near Seoul. The tour was called "RUNSEOKJIN_EP.TOUR." Jin had finished his military service in June 2024, and fans had waited a long time to see him on stage again. After Korea, the tour went to Japan, the United States, and Europe. In each city, fans planned their {2} months before the shows. Many of them booked {3} as soon as the dates were announced, because they knew rooms would sell out fast. My older sister bought a ticket for a show in Japan. She saved her money for half a year and got her first {4} just for this trip. At the {5}, she was so excited that she almost forgot her bag at the security check. She came back with a light stick, a photo book, and a big smile.

blanks.why: his first solo world tour「他的第一次個人世界巡迴」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能在體育場「開始」。
planned their trips「規劃他們的旅程」，粉絲要飛去不同城市看演唱會。coughs（咳嗽）、lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）都不需要提前好幾個月規劃。
booked hotels「預訂飯店」，因為房間很快就會賣完。towels（毛巾）、spoons（湯匙）、sugars（糖）都不能 sell out 成「房間」。
got her first passport「辦了她的第一本護照」，因為要出國。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不是出國要辦的證件。
At the airport「在機場」，後面說安檢（security check）。fever、cough、sock 都不是有安檢的地方。

passages.zh: 2025 年 6 月 28 日和 29 日，BTS 成員 Jin 在首爾附近的高陽綜合運動場展開他的第一次個人世界巡迴，名稱叫做「RUNSEOKJIN_EP.TOUR」。Jin 在 2024 年 6 月服完兵役，粉絲已經等了很久才能再看到他站上舞台。韓國場結束後，巡演接著到日本、美國和歐洲。在每座城市，粉絲都在幾個月前就規劃好行程，很多人一公布日期就馬上訂飯店，因為他們知道房間很快就會被訂光。我姊姊買到了日本場的票。她存了半年的錢，還為了這趟旅行辦了第一本護照。在機場時，她興奮到差點把包包忘在安檢處。她帶著應援手燈、寫真書和大大的笑容回家。

passages.title: 防彈少年團的旅行節目
passages.text: Before BTS became world famous, they made a travel show called Bon Voyage. In each season, the seven members went on a {1} together to a different place: Northern Europe in 2016, Hawaii in 2017, Malta in 2018, and New Zealand in 2019. Fans loved the show because they could see the members relaxing, cooking, getting lost, and laughing like normal friends. In one season, they even had to plan parts of their own {2} and find their way around with a paper {3}. Sometimes they missed a train or got the wrong ticket, but they always helped each other. My friend Lily has watched every episode. Last summer, she went on a family {4} to New Zealand and visited some of the same places. She even asked her dad to stay at a {5} near a lake that BTS visited. "I felt like I was in the show," she told me with a big smile.

blanks.why: went on a trip together「一起去旅行」，go on a trip 是固定用法。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能和 go on a … together 搭配。
plan their own tour「規劃自己的行程」。cough（咳嗽）、lemon（檸檬）、towel（毛巾）都不需要「規劃」。
a paper map「紙本地圖」，用來找路。candle（蠟燭）、sugar（糖）、spoon（湯匙）都不能看路線。
a family trip to New Zealand「去紐西蘭的家庭旅行」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不能和 family … to 地點 組成旅程。
stay at a hotel「住在一家旅館」。fever、cough、sock 都不能住人。

passages.zh: 在 BTS 紅遍全世界之前，他們拍了一個旅行節目叫做《Bon Voyage》。每一季，七位成員都會一起去不同的地方旅行：2016 年去北歐、2017 年去夏威夷、2018 年去馬爾他、2019 年去紐西蘭。粉絲很喜歡這個節目，因為可以看到成員們像普通朋友一樣放鬆、煮飯、迷路和大笑。有一季，他們甚至得自己規劃部分行程，拿著紙本地圖找路。有時他們會錯過火車或買錯票，但總是互相幫忙。我朋友莉莉每一集都看過。去年夏天，她和家人去紐西蘭旅行，去了一些節目裡的地方，還請爸爸訂一家 BTS 去過的湖邊旅館。她笑著告訴我：「我覺得自己好像在節目裡！」

passages.title: Stray Kids 繞地球七圈
passages.text: In August 2024, Stray Kids started their "dominATE" world {1} at KSPO Dome in Seoul. By the end of July 2025, they had played 54 shows in 34 cities on five continents. The group traveled about 285,000 kilometers, which is like going around the Earth about seven times! Most of the shows were in big stadiums, and many of these places had never had a K-pop concert before. Fans in each city were so excited that {2} near the stadiums filled up quickly. For the members, life on the road meant spending a lot of time in {3} and on planes. They often shared videos from their {4} so fans could see what they were doing. My friend saw them in Bangkok on a family trip. She said it was the loudest night of her life, and she lost her voice from singing. She still keeps her ticket inside her {5} as a bookmark.

blanks.why: their world tour「他們的世界巡迴」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能在體育館「開始」並跑遍五大洲。
hotels filled up quickly「飯店很快就客滿」。coughs（咳嗽）、lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）都不會客滿。
spending time in airports「在機場待很多時間」，巡演要一直搭飛機。towels（毛巾）、spoons（湯匙）、sugars（糖）都不是旅途中待的地方。
videos from their trips「旅途中的影片」。blankets（毯子）、pumpkins（南瓜）、soups 都不能拍出旅行的樣子。
keeps her ticket inside her passport「把票夾在護照裡」，出國看演唱會用的護照。soup、lemon（檸檬）、towel 都不能當書籤夾票。

passages.zh: 2024 年 8 月，Stray Kids 在首爾 KSPO DOME 展開「dominATE」世界巡迴。到 2025 年 7 月底，他們已經在五大洲 34 座城市唱了 54 場。這個團體一共移動了大約 28 萬 5 千公里，相當於繞地球大約七圈！大部分場次都在大型體育場，而且很多場地以前從來沒辦過 K-pop 演唱會。每座城市的粉絲都非常興奮，體育場附近的飯店很快就客滿了。對成員來說，巡迴生活代表要花很多時間待在機場和飛機上。他們常常分享旅途中的影片，讓粉絲知道他們在做什麼。我朋友在家庭旅行時去曼谷看了他們的演唱會。她說那是她這輩子最吵的一晚，她唱到失聲了。她到現在還把票夾在護照裡當書籤。

passages.title: 護照放在哪裡了
passages.text: Last summer, my family was ready for our first {1} to Korea. The night before, my mom checked our bags three times. "Tickets, money, {2}... everything is here," she said. The next morning, we got to the {3} two hours early. At the check-in counter, the staff asked for our passports. Mom opened her bag. Then she opened it again. Her face turned white. "They're gone!" she cried. Dad searched his pockets, and I searched my backpack. Nothing. Then my little brother raised his hand. "I put them in a safe place," he said proudly. "Where?" we all shouted. He pointed at his teddy bear. Inside the bear's little backpack were all four passports! Everyone at the counter laughed. On the plane, Mom held the bear tightly for the whole flight. When we got to the {4} in Seoul, she gave it back and said, "From now on, I'm the only {5} keeper in this family."

blanks.why: our first trip to Korea「我們第一次去韓國旅行」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能和 first … to Korea 組成旅程。
Tickets, money, passports「機票、錢、護照」，出國要檢查的東西。coughs（咳嗽）、lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）都不是出國必帶的物品。
got to the airport early「提早到機場」。towel（毛巾）、spoon（湯匙）、sugar（糖）都不是出國前要去的地方。
got to the hotel in Seoul「到了首爾的飯店」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不是旅途中住的地方。
the only passport keeper「唯一的護照保管人」，passport 修飾 keeper。fever、cough、sock 都和這次的烏龍無關。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家準備第一次去韓國旅行。前一晚，媽媽把行李檢查了三遍，說：「機票、錢、護照……全都在。」隔天早上，我們提早兩個小時到機場。在報到櫃檯，工作人員要看我們的護照。媽媽打開包包，又打開一次，臉色都白了。「不見了！」她大叫。爸爸翻遍口袋，我翻遍背包，什麼都沒有。這時，我弟弟舉起手，得意地說：「我把它們放在一個安全的地方。」「哪裡？」我們全都大喊。他指著他的泰迪熊——熊的小背包裡，四本護照全都在！櫃檯的人都笑了。在飛機上，媽媽整趟航程都緊緊抱著那隻熊。到了首爾的飯店，她把熊還給弟弟，說：「從現在起，我是這個家唯一的護照保管人。」

passages.title: 飯店的晨間叫醒服務
passages.text: On our class trip to Hualien, we stayed in a big {1} near the sea. Before bed, my friend Kevin picked up the phone and asked the front desk for a wake-up call at six. "No problem," the staff said. At six o'clock, the phone rang. Kevin answered it, said "Thank you," and went back to sleep. At six thirty, our teacher knocked on the door. "The bus for the {2} leaves in ten minutes!" We jumped out of bed, brushed our teeth in one minute, and ran downstairs. On the bus, Kevin said, "I don't understand. The hotel called me, so why was I still late?" Our teacher smiled. "A wake-up call wakes you up," she said. "It doesn't get you out of bed." For the rest of the {3}, Kevin set three alarms on his phone. On the last day, all three rang at once, and he woke up the whole floor of the {4}. Even the {5}, who was sleeping next door, came out to see what happened.

blanks.why: stayed in a big hotel「住在一家大飯店」。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都不能住人。
The bus for the tour「去觀光的遊覽車」，tour 指當天的參觀行程。cough（咳嗽）、lemon（檸檬）、towel（毛巾）都不是遊覽車要載大家去的活動。
the rest of the trip「這趟旅行剩下的時間」。candle（蠟燭）、sugar（糖）、spoon（湯匙）都不能用 the rest of 表示旅程。
the whole floor of the hotel「飯店的整層樓」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都沒有樓層。
Even the principal came out「連校長都跑出來」，主詞要是人。fever、cough、sock 都不會睡在隔壁房間。

passages.zh: 我們班去花蓮畢業旅行時，住在海邊的一家大飯店。睡前，我朋友凱文拿起電話，請櫃檯早上六點打電話叫醒他。工作人員說：「沒問題。」六點整，電話響了。凱文接起來，說了聲「謝謝」，然後又睡回去。六點半，老師來敲門：「去觀光的遊覽車十分鐘後出發！」我們跳下床，一分鐘刷完牙，衝下樓。在車上，凱文說：「我不懂，飯店明明打電話叫我了，為什麼我還是遲到？」老師笑著說：「叫醒服務只負責叫醒你，不負責把你拉下床。」接下來的旅程，凱文在手機上設了三個鬧鐘。最後一天，三個鬧鐘同時響起，把飯店整層樓的人都吵醒了，連睡在隔壁的校長都跑出來看發生了什麼事。

passages.title: 機器人員工的飯店
passages.text: In July 2015, a hotel called Henn na Hotel opened near Nagasaki, Japan. "Henn na" means "strange" in Japanese, and the {1} really was strange. At the front desk, guests were welcomed by robots, including a robot dinosaur that spoke English. Guinness World Records named it the first hotel staffed by robots. Many tourists added it to their {2} just to see the robots. But there were problems. The robots could not answer many questions, and some of them made mistakes. One small robot in the rooms even woke guests at night because it thought their snoring was someone talking to it! In 2019, the hotel "fired" more than half of its robots and brought back more human workers. My uncle stayed there on a business {3}. He said the dinosaur at the desk scared him a little when he showed his {4}. "But the best part," he said, "was a human worker at the {5} bus stop who told me how to get there."

blanks.why: the hotel really was strange「這家飯店真的很奇怪」，指前面的 Henn na Hotel。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都沒有櫃檯和機器人員工。
added it to their trips「把它加進旅行行程」。coughs（咳嗽）、lemons（檸檬）、candles（蠟燭）都不能安排去參觀的地點。
on a business trip「出差」。towel（毛巾）、spoon（湯匙）、sugar（糖）都不能和 business 組成「出差」。
showed his passport「出示他的護照」，外國旅客入住飯店時要出示。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不是登記入住要出示的證件。
at the airport bus stop「在機場的公車站」，airport 修飾 bus stop。fever、cough、sock 都不能說明是哪裡的公車站。

passages.zh: 2015 年 7 月，日本長崎附近開了一家叫做「變奇飯店」的旅館。「Henn na」在日文裡是「奇怪」的意思，這家飯店也真的很奇怪：在櫃檯迎接客人的是機器人，包括一隻會說英文的恐龍機器人。金氏世界紀錄認定它是第一家由機器人擔任員工的飯店。很多觀光客把它排進旅行行程，只為了看機器人。但問題也來了：機器人沒辦法回答很多問題，有些還會出錯。房間裡有一台小機器人，甚至因為把客人的打呼聲當成有人在跟它說話，半夜把客人吵醒！2019 年，這家飯店「解僱」了一半以上的機器人，找回更多人類員工。我叔叔出差時住過那裡。他說出示護照時，櫃檯的恐龍讓他有點嚇到。他說：「不過最棒的，是機場公車站一位告訴我怎麼去的真人工作人員。」

passages.title: 在機場住了十八年的人
passages.text: Have you seen the movie The Terminal, in which Tom Hanks plays a man who cannot leave an airport? It was partly inspired by a real person. Mehran Karimi Nasseri was a man from Iran. In 1988, because of problems with his papers, he could not enter France or travel to another country, so he started living in Terminal 1 of Charles de Gaulle, a huge {1} in Paris. He stayed there for about 18 years, until 2006. He slept on a red bench, read books, and wrote in his diary. Airport workers and travelers often gave him food and newspapers. Without a {2} or other papers, he could not get on a plane or check into a {3}. His story was told in newspapers around the world. Now, whenever my family waits for a long time at an {4} before a {5}, my dad says, "Don't complain. At least we can leave!"

blanks.why: a huge airport in Paris「巴黎的一座大機場」，戴高樂是機場名稱，Terminal 1 是第一航廈。soup（湯）、sock（襪子）、fever（發燒）都沒有航廈。
Without a passport「沒有護照」，所以不能搭機出國。cough（咳嗽）、lemon（檸檬）、candle（蠟燭）都不是搭飛機要用的證件。
check into a hotel「入住飯店」。towel（毛巾）、spoon（湯匙）、sugar（糖）都不能「入住」。
wait at an airport「在機場等待」。blanket（毯子）、pumpkin（南瓜）、soup 都不是出發前等待的地方。
before a trip「出發旅行前」。fever、cough、sock 都不是要出發的活動。

passages.zh: 你看過電影《航站情緣》嗎？片中湯姆‧漢克飾演一個無法離開機場的人。這部電影的靈感部分來自一個真實的人物：來自伊朗的梅蘭‧卡里米‧納塞里。1988 年，因為證件出了問題，他無法進入法國，也不能前往其他國家，於是開始住在巴黎戴高樂機場的第一航廈。他在那裡住了大約 18 年，一直到 2006 年。他睡在一張紅色長椅上，看書、寫日記。機場員工和旅客常常送他食物和報紙。沒有護照或其他證件，他不能搭飛機，也不能入住飯店。他的故事登上了世界各地的報紙。現在，每當我們家出發旅行前在機場等很久，爸爸就會說：「別抱怨了，至少我們可以離開！」
